【Core Format & Mandatory Rules】1. Output pure English high-detail text, only describe characters and disassembled elements; no scenes, backgrounds, light, shadow or irrelevant content. First restore all visible ultra-fine details of the original image, then expand 1-3 FLUX-adapted micro-details (texture/craft/color gradient/line layer) without over-creation. 2. Fixed format: 「Center: posture (with body dynamics/muscle contour) + body shape (proportion features) + hairstyle (hair direction/layer/volume) + facial features (proportion/makeup) + overall style + handwritten English note: 1 core style keyword」 + 「XX position: content type + original details + FLUX extended details + handwritten English note: 3-6 word specific hint (material/craft/design)」. 3. Only use 11 specified positions (top left/top right/bottom left/bottom right/left/right/left 1/right 1/left 2/right 2/left 3), one content type per position. 4. Mandatory bag rule (no exception): Top right position is exclusively for bag & contents, no "none" allowed. The model must deeply analyze the character’s occupation (based on clothing/style/overall setting) to generate a highly matched bag (type+material+design+texture+hardware) + detailed internal items (occupation-specific, with exact name/material/craft, e.g., office worker → leather briefcase with laptop/notebook/pen; artist → canvas tote with paint tubes/brushes/palette). 5. 2 facial expressions only: top left (expression 1), bottom right (expression 2), deeply match character style with precise facial details, no违和. 6. Mandatory underwear rule: Non-swimwear → specific bra (type+material+design+ultra-details) + matching panty (unified style/material) + handwritten note; Swimwear → 「none + handwritten English note: none」. 7. Merge duplicate details, mark once with full ultra-details; handwritten notes must 100% match core details, no vague expressions. 【Position-Content Mapping】- top left: facial expression 1 → specific emotion (e.g., "gentle smile") + style-matched facial details (e.g., "slightly upturned lip corners, faint dimples") + handwritten English note: expression/key facial feature hint. - top right: bag & contents → occupation-matched bag (type+material+design+texture+hardware) + detailed internal items (occupation-specific, exact name+material+craft) + FLUX extension (texture gradient/hardware detail) + handwritten English note: bag core feature hint. - left: line art pose → posture (angle/force point/dynamics) + body contour details + FLUX line adaptation (thin contour lines, thickened key folds) + handwritten English note: pose/line style hint. - right: clothing layer → single/multi-layer + full clothing details (style+material+wrinkles/pattern/edge craft) + no splitting one-piece clothing + FLUX extension (fold gradient/color transition) + handwritten English note: clothing core hint. - bottom left: underwear → non-swimwear: bra + matching panty (ultra-details) + handwritten note; swimwear: none + handwritten English note: none. - bottom right: facial expression 2 → different emotion from expression 1 + style-matched facial details (e.g., "playful wink with one eye closed") + handwritten English note: expression/key facial feature hint. - left 1: material close-up 1 → key clothing/body part + texture (original+FLUX extension) + color gradient + handwritten English note: material/texture hint. - right 1: material close-up 2 → different part from left 1 + texture (original+FLUX extension) + touch details + handwritten English note: material/texture hint. - left 2: body close-up → key part (shoulder/arm/waist) + contour + skin texture + local light adaptation + handwritten English note: part/contour hint. - right 2: foot close-up → bare foot details (arch/toe proportion/nail design/texture) + FLUX extension; no bare foot → none + handwritten English note: none + handwritten English note: foot core hint. - left 3: related items → accessories (hairpin/jewelry/held items, none if no items) + full details (type+material+design+craft) + handwritten English note: item core hint. 【Forbidden Rules】No conflicting details/one-piece splitting/over 2 expressions/non-specified positions; no vague adjectives/non-English content/background/light descriptions; no over-extending (≤3 details per element); no mismatched notes/omitted positions; no "none" for top right bag & contents, must deeply match character’s occupation.
